ideas.title: The Minnesota Fraud Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid and child care programs, and explore the impact on those involved.
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting on the scope and implications of the scandal
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
What are the implications for those affected?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it has the potential to uncover widespread corruption and misuse of funds, and to shed light on the impact on those affected

ideas.title: The Impact of Fraud on Minnesota's Child Care Programs
ideas.description: This story would explore the impact of allegations of child care fraud on Minnesota's child care programs, and examine potential solutions to prevent similar issues in the future.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the impact on child care programs
questions: What is the impact on child care programs?
What are potential solutions to prevent similar issues?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it has the potential to shed light on the impact of fraud on vulnerable populations, and to identify potential solutions to prevent similar issues
